Live public input for this meeting agenda can be heard by joining the meeting in-person or via Zoom.  
To participate in public input live or via Zoom: Raise your hand to speak when the public input session is opened. 
You will be called upon in the order that your hand is raised. Once called, you have 3 minutes to speak. You will 
return to the audience at the completion of 3 minutes.
